sections.summary: 7-Day replacement or full refund window for broken, damaged, or unsealed harvest packages.
sections.content: Interesting provides a 7-day hassle-free replacement or full refund guarantee if any product arrives damaged, unsealed, or fails our freshness standard. Report any issue within 7 days of delivery for instant resolution.

sections.summary: 24 to 48 business hours refund turnaround to UPI, Card, or Bank.
sections.content: Approved refunds are credited directly to your UPI ID (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), original debit/credit card, or bank account within 24 to 48 business hours. Zero hidden deduction fees.

sections.summary: Free reverse pickup across 19,000+ PIN codes; no physical return needed for food safety in most cases.
sections.content: We arrange a 100% free doorstep reverse pickup from your home across 19,000+ PIN codes in India. In many food safety scenarios, physical parcel return is not even required—simply sharing clear photos of the damaged container on WhatsApp or email is sufficient.

sections.summary: 3-step replacement process: take photos, WhatsApp order ID to support, receive replacement in 24 hours.
sections.content: To request a replacement: 1. Take clear photos of the damaged canister seal or outer box with invoice. 2. WhatsApp our support concierge at +91 99948 47167 or email support@intersting.duckdns.org with your Order ID. 3. Fresh replacement canister is dispatched within 24 hours.
